Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sponsor slot — can we get a "tight" 7-minute stage script?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for agreeing to the sponsored spotlight slot at Vertex Summit. Our programming lead asked for a speaker-friendly 7-minute script (with a 60–90s rapid demo) that highlights: latency/cost tradeoffs, a concrete customer outcome, and an actionable CTA.

Could you share a draft by EOD PT today? We likely need two short variants — one developer-focused, one exec-focused — that we can give to the MC and to the booth emcee. Also: our AV team needs clear timings for the demo sequence (slides + live demo + audience Q).

Attaching the event run-of-show for context. Dan from BrightSpark is looping on staging logistics.

Appreciate it — Sara

Attachments: VTX_RunOfShow.pdf (attachment stub)

Sara — thanks, got it. Pushing a first pass attached: stage_script_v3.docx. This includes two variants (developer + exec) and inline timing markers for slides 1–6 plus the demo window.

Quick notes:
- Developer variant trims the intro to 45s and adds a one-liner about KV-cache and batching.
- Exec variant keeps a short customer result example (50% cost reduction) and a CTA to schedule a deep-dive with our solutions team.

Lauren and Monica — can you both do a focused pass on: 1) opening hook (make it sharper), 2) the demo cadence (who types, who narrates), and 3) a 1-sentence customer quote we can slot in?

I'll also map the timing to the AV cues and share an XLS with exact second markers once you confirm the demo steps.

Thanks,

Nice first pass — I tightened the opener and suggested two micro-edits inline (see comments in the doc). Biggest asks:

- Opener: replace the generic line with a quick problem statement ("Customers pay for the wrong tokens when caches miss — and that adds up").
- Demo: shift the live demo to show a 30s cold path then a 30s cached path to make the economics tangible on stage.
- Quote: suggest using the short line from Vertex Prod Lead (Sara suggested a 50% cost reduction — can we get a one-liner from her that reads well on stage?).

Small note to Marcus — keep the exec variant under 80 words for the MC handoff. Monica — adding you for choreography and timing validation.

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsor slot — can we get a "tight" 7-minute stage script?

Thanks — reviewed the doc and added choreography notes below.

- Timing: allocate 60s intro (MC handoff), 90s demo (30s cold / 30s cached / 30s callouts), 60s customer quote + takeaways, 60s CTA + exit. That adds to ~6min and leaves a small buffer.
- Roles: Marcus narrates; Lauren handles the handoff; Sara (or MC) reads the customer quote.
- AV cues: slide 3 (demo start) == countdown tick at T-5s; we need a freeze frame option after the cached run to overlay cost delta.
- Tech check: bring an offline copy of the quantized model (~1.2GB) and a fallback short video in case network latency spikes.

Attached: live-flow-timing.xlsx with second-level markers and a proposed AV cue sheet.

Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Field Comms
Redwood Inference
